purpose: Teach: エンジェル/ルーマニア/ミレニアム/ギルド/ワイドショー/クリエイター/サイレント/ロフト

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエンジェル像のお土産を下さったわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad brought back an angel statue from his trip.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Gentle delivery, like sharing a small gift of news. Slight pause after 'Sho' to let the boy's attention settle. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとルーマニアのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about Romania.
lines.style: Bright, eager voice from a six-year-old. Quick, animated delivery—he wants her to know he did something grown-up with Dad. Slight breathless quality from excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ミレニアム前夜は緊張した」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad was talking about how tense he felt before the millennium.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured tone. Gentle wonder in her voice. She's reflecting on what her husband shared, inviting the boy into something meaningful. Warm but contemplative.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと中世のギルドのドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched a documentary about medieval guilds.
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery again. Sho's voice bright and present, eager to share another moment. Not quite as breathless as before—settling into the rhythm of telling her things.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが朝のワイドショーを観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad's watching the morning variety show.
lines.style: Observational, gentle tone. She's noticing something her husband is doing now, sharing it with her son. Light, almost amused—a small domestic moment. Warm but understated.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクリエイターの作品集を見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked through a creator's portfolio together.
lines.style: Sho's voice still animated but slightly more settled. He's listing accomplishments now—less breathless excitement, more pride in sharing time. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサイレント映画の名作を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho—your dad's watching a classic silent film.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. She's noting something her husband enjoys, speaking with quiet admiration for his taste. Gentle, almost tender. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと家のロフトを片付けたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I cleaned out the loft at home together.
lines.style: Sho's voice bright and satisfied—this is real work he did with Dad, not just watching something. Proud closure to the list. Clean, direct delivery with warmth underneath.
